tokens.name: card
tokens.role: Cards, panels and popovers. Always opaque

tokens.name: muted
tokens.role: Quiet fills: inputs, chips, hover on lists

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.role: Secondary text and icons. Passes AA on card and muted

tokens.name: primary
tokens.role: Main buttons, the selected tab, progress bars

tokens.name: ring
tokens.role: Keyboard focus outline. Passes 3:1 on card

tokens.name: success
tokens.role: Done, approved, allowed. Never the brand colour

tokens.name: warning
tokens.role: Needs review, waiting, retrying. Never the brand colour

tokens.name: danger
tokens.role: Failed, blocked, hard to undo. Follows shadcn's --destructive when your project has it
